sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The map in Escape from Tarkov consists of 13 different locations. While they are separated from each other, it is possible to transit between them without leaving a round.

sections.heading: Location selection
sections.text:
Most maps are initially locked in the location selection and get unlocked by progressing through the story chapter Tour. A red skull icon indicates the guaranteed presence of a boss at that location.

sections.heading: Minefields
sections.text:
Minefields are usually marked by warning signs, but there are also a few unmarked ones (e.g. west of the USEC camp on Woods).
The mines are invisible, respawn after they detonate and can only be triggered by players. It is therefore impossible to detect a mine, let alone clear a minefield. When entering a minefield, triggering a mine is chance-based.
While they are used to create artificial borders on Woods, Shoreline, Ground Zero, Interchange and Reserve, they can also be found along the harbor terminal wall on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Border Snipers
sections.text:
Border Snipers are marked by various warning signs. They are invisible, non-killable and can shoot through any object. They should be avoided under all circumstances, not least because the player's health will be set to 1% after dying to them.
It is therefore essential for survival to retreat immediately when being targeted by one, as taking cover is pointless.
They are used to create artificial borders on Customs, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods, Shoreline, Ground Zero, Interchange and Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Claymores
sections.text:
Claymores are directional anti-personnel mines. The mines have an activation range of 5-10m, are unaffected by gunfire and explosives and instantly kill players upon detonation, unless they are behind cover. Unlike the minefield, once blown up another doesn't respawn in its place, allowing claymores to be permanently cleared after detonation. Claymores can only be detonated by getting into their activation range.

They are used on the Lighthouse, Ground Zero and Streets of Tarkov locations:
- On Lighthouse they are scattered on the bridge to the lighthouse at the peninsula territory. It is possible to safely pass them with an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter.
- On Ground Zero one is located inside the Tarbank, in customer desk booth no. 3.
- On Streets of Tarkov they are scattered around the LexOs car dealership.
